This reminds me of when I lost my small website company back in the day. Had done a 5-year education on design and animation. That ended up translating in me and a buddy setting up a design company. We'd do all the design stuff, but I specialized in building websites.

Then came the advent of "DIY Website builders" like squarespace and others.  It didn't completely wipe-out the webdesign branche. But for a small company like us, who were making a lot of small websites for small companies, it was the end. People could just do it themselves now for near free. 

We'd have to specialize and focus on high-end websites for big companies who wanted an exact product tailor made. I decided against and left the company. He reforged the company into a branding agency. 

So, conclusion, this won't take all jobs from programmers. But it's going to take a slice of the pie. And as it gets better it will take a bigger and bigger slice.  Get ready.
